places.raw_name: the trail / a little knobby hill
places.name: First day's trail north of Lonesome Dove
places.note: The herd of about 2,600 sets out in choking dust; Newt nearly loses strays; Call and Gus watch from a knoll as Deets returns to lead them to bed-ground.
places.location_hint: open chaparral flats with scattered mesquite a few miles north of Lonesome Dove; from a low knoll the town, the Rio Grande and Mexico are still visible; south of the brush country and San Antonio

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Seen in the distance from the hill; Augustus feels a whiskey might make him sentimental about it, Call does not.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, visible from the first day's trail

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Augustus marks leaving the river they patrolled so long and wants a speech; it is still visible behind them.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Visible beyond the river from the knoll as the drive begins.

places.name: Brush Country
places.note: A dense mesquite belt between them and San Antonio; Call asks whether to go through it, Gus says go through.
places.location_hint: thick mesquite band north of the border flats and south of San Antonio

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Lies beyond the brush country the herd must cross.

places.name: Texas Gulf Coast
places.note: The mosquito-ridden alternative route around the brush that Augustus rejects.
places.location_hint: Gulf of Mexico shore of south Texas

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Augustus doubts the rickety wagon will last that far.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Newt fears riding there blind in the dust and worries about disgracing himself before arriving.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Augustus says thorn-pricked Jake wished he'd stayed there and accepted his hanging.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Call reflects that fighting Indians and guarding the border were needed to settle Texas and hold the south.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.at: First day's trail north of Lonesome Dove
groups.hint: herd strung out a mile through chaparral, heading to Deets's chosen bed-ground northwest at sunset

groups.label: Augustus
groups.at: First day's trail north of Lonesome Dove
groups.hint: lingering alone on a knoll watching the sunset and herd
